package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for date_or_cast_wrapped_indexed_column: DATE/CAST wrapping indexed columns in WHERE clauses, preventing index usage.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.

type Order struct {
	ID        int
	CreatedAt string
	Amount    string
}

func FindOrdersToday(db *gorm.DB) ([]Order, error) {
	var orders []Order
	err := db.Where("DATE(created_at) = ?", "2026-05-09").
		Order("id").Find(&orders).Error
	return orders, err
}

func FindOrdersByAmount(db *gorm.DB, threshold int) ([]Order, error) {
	var orders []Order
	err := db.Where("CAST(amount AS INT) > ?", threshold).Find(&orders).Error
	return orders, err
}
